Subject: Requesting exec OK: HelixPoint welcome funding + 2-week pilot stretch

Hi Aditya / Marissa —

Quick ask for executive sign-off on a combined concession for HelixPoint (early-stage buyer in payments). They've requested two items to close the pilot:

- One-time welcome credit of $10k to be applied against usage during the pilot (applies only to hosted usage).
- Extend the pilot by 14 days (no additional seat fees) to finish integrations and run the fraud model evaluation.

Why this matters: HelixPoint is in live integration with our SDK; marketing has committed to a joint webinar if we hit the pilot success metrics. We believe an extra two weeks + the credit materially increases conversion probability to a Reserved Dedicated PoC. Economics: this is an up-front cost exposure of ~$10k; expected ARR if converted > $180k/year.

Attached: HelixPoint_Pilot_Summary_v3.pdf (pilot objectives + success metrics) and WelcomeCredit_Schedule.xlsx (billing handling).

Requested approvals / asks:
- Aditya: exec approval for combined welcome credit and pilot extension (need final word on amount and term).
- Marissa: confirm we can route the credit as a contra invoice (finance) and whether legal needs a one-off addendum.

Timing: Sarah (HelixPoint) is hoping to announce the webinar on 2028-01-24, so a decision by EOD 2028-01-19 would keep momentum.

Thanks —

—Stephanie
